examInfo.format: 12 Single Choice + 4 Multiple Choice (Prüfungsstil, mit Rechenfragen)
examInfo.grading: Übungsset ohne Note — Ziel: ≥ 60 % der Punkte

questions.text:
A company has to set the size of a new call centre but has no own experience. A relationship between the number of key products sold and the number of incoming calls can be assumed.

Which method class should be preferred first?

choices.text: Time series method (moving average of past calls)
Naive method (last observed value)
Qualitative method (expert opinion only)
Causal method (regression on products sold)

questions.explanation: Die Anrufzahl (abhängige Variable) hängt von den verkauften Produkten (unabhängige Variable) ab. Ohne eigene Historie ist die Time-Series-Methode nicht möglich, die Regression nutzt den bekannten Treiber.

questions.text: Which formula calculates the MAPE for a single period t?

choices.text: |Actual_t − Forecast_t| / Forecast_t
|Actual_t − Forecast_t| / Actual_t
(Actual_t − Forecast_t)² / Actual_t
(Actual_t − Forecast_t) / Actual_t

questions.explanation: MAPE = |Ist − Prognose| / Ist. Ohne Betrag wäre es der (vorzeichenbehaftete) relative Fehler, mit Prognose im Nenner falsche Basis, quadriert wäre es eine MSE-Variante.

questions.text: A series has 36 monthly observations. A moving average MA(4) is used. For how many periods can MAD, MSE and MAPE be calculated?
questions.explanation: MA(4) liefert die erste Prognose in Periode 5. Fehler existieren nur für die Perioden 5 bis 36, also 36 − 4 = 32 Werte.

questions.text:
Exponential smoothing with α = 0.4: the last actual value is y_t = 50 and the last forecast is F_t = 40.

What is the forecast for the next period?

The last three monthly demands are y(t−1) = 120, y(t−2) = 100, y(t−3) = 80. A weighted moving average uses the weights 0.5 (t−1), 0.3 (t−2), 0.2 (t−3).

What is the forecast for the next month?
questions.explanation: WMA = 0.5·120 + 0.3·100 + 0.2·80 = 60 + 30 + 16 = 106. Der einfache Durchschnitt wäre 100; das höchste Gewicht gehört zum neuesten Wert.

questions.text:
Actual demand: 10, 12, 14, 16. Forecast: 11, 11, 15, 13.

What is the Mean Absolute Deviation (MAD)?
Quarterly sales are decomposed with a centered moving average CMA(4). For which period t is the FIRST CMA(4) value available?
questions.explanation: Gerades k = 4: MA über t = 1..4 und t = 2..5 werden zentriert und gehören zu t = 3. Am Anfang und am Ende fehlen je k/2 = 2 Perioden.

questions.text:
For the first quarter, the seasonal ratios of three years are 0.80, 0.84 and 0.88.

What is the seasonal index of the first quarter?
questions.explanation: Der Seasonal Index ist der Durchschnitt aller Seasonal Ratios derselben Saison: (0.80 + 0.84 + 0.88)/3 = 0.84. Der Index bedeutet: Q1 liegt im Schnitt 16 % unter dem Durchschnitt.

questions.text:
A regression on the deseasonalized demand gives Demand = 1'200 + 15·t. The seasonal index of the target month is 0.90.

What is the seasonal forecast for t = 40?
questions.explanation: Trend t = 40: 1'200 + 600 = 1'800. Re-Seasonalisierung durch Multiplikation: 1'800 · 0.90 = 1'620. Division würde 2'000 ergeben.

questions.text:
A linear trend analysis on 60 weeks of data gives intercept 100 and slope 4 per week.

What is the forecast for week 61?
questions.explanation: ŷ = 100 + 4 · 61 = 344. Der x-Wert ist der Zeitindex der Zielwoche (61), nicht 60.

questions.text: In a decomposition, the seasonal ratio of an observation is calculated as…

choices.text: actual demand divided by the CMA
actual demand divided by the fitted trend line
CMA divided by the annual average
actual demand multiplied by the CMA

questions.explanation: Seasonal Ratio = Ist / CMA, denn der CMA glättet die Saison heraus. Wer durch die Trendgerade teilt, erhält falsche Indices (Summe ≠ k).

questions.text: Quarterly series of 12 periods: a fit with MAPE 8 % for method A and 11 % for method B. What can be concluded?

choices.text: Method A is on average closer to the actual values in relative terms
Both methods are equally good
No conclusion is possible because MAPE has a unit
Method B is better because its MAPE is higher

questions.explanation: Kleineres MAPE = im Mittel geringere relative Abweichung. MAPE ist einheitenlos und gerade deshalb zum Methodenvergleich geeignet.

sections.title: Part B – Multiple Choice (4 Points)
sections.description: At least two answers are correct. Only the complete correct combination scores (no partial points).

questions.text: Which statements about forecast error measures are correct?

choices.text: The MSE puts more weight on large deviations than on small ones.
The MAD is not suitable if the actual demand can be zero.
If the ME is 0, the MSE is also 0.
The MAPE is not suitable if the actual demand can become zero.
The Mean Error (ME) is not suitable for the final evaluation because positive and negative errors cancel out.

questions.explanation: ME: Fehler gleichen sich aus. MSE quadriert und bestraft grosse Fehler überproportional. MAPE teilt durch Ist ⇒ Problem bei 0. MAD ist ein Betragsmittel und nie negativ und hat kein Nullproblem. ME = 0 sagt nichts über Einzelfehler.

questions.text: Which statements about exponential smoothing are correct?

choices.text: Simplex LP is the appropriate Solver method for optimising α.
With a rising trend the forecast tends to lag below the actual demand.
An α close to 0 means that the forecast follows the last actual value almost exactly.
A larger α makes the forecast react faster to recent changes.
The smoothing factor can be optimised with the Excel Solver (GRG Nonlinear).

questions.explanation: Startwert F1 = y1. Grosses α = reaktiv. Bei steigendem Trend hinkt ES hinterher. α wird per GRG Nonlinear optimiert, nicht per Simplex LP (nicht-linear). α → 0 heisst fast keine Anpassung, α → 1 folgt dem letzten Wert.

questions.text: Which statements about seasonal decomposition with the CMA are correct?

choices.text: For an even k (e.g. 12) a centering step is required.
The seasonal indices of 12 months should add up to approximately 12.
Reseasonalizing a trend forecast is done by dividing by the seasonal index.
The seasonal forecast is obtained by multiplying the trend value by the seasonal index.
The last six periods of a CMA(12) can be calculated with the same formula.

questions.explanation: Gerades k braucht Zentrierung (Mittel zweier MAs), ungerades nicht. Indices summieren zu ≈ k. Re-Seasonalisierung = Multiplikation. Am Ende fehlen k/2 = 6 Perioden (not possible to calculate).

questions.text: Which statements about forecasting method classes are correct?

choices.text: Qualitative methods are suitable when no or only expensive quantitative data is available.
Causal methods can only be used for short-term forecasts.
Time series methods assume that the past is relevant for the future.
Qualitative methods are the first choice when long, clean historical data exists.
Causal methods model the demand as a function of explanatory variables.

questions.explanation: Qualitativ: fehlende/teure Daten, Neuprodukte (z. B. Delphi). Zeitreihen: Vergangenheit ist relevant. Kausal: Regression mit Treibern (Preis, Temperatur). Bei langer Historie ist qualitativ gerade nicht die erste Wahl.
